verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AI-branded features, including an AI-powered inbox, AI scheduling and AI-driven conversation automation, plus a custom SalesBot language with a visual editor. None of it documents users operating the CRM through natural-language commands. The llms.txt docs index helps agents read the API documentation; it is not a natural-language control interface for the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
